section.54: The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour

54.name_native: The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour

hadiths.text: Ibn 'Umar reported that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying (in a state) that he had turned his face towards the east:Behold, turmoil would appear from this side, from where the horns of Satan would appear
